components.title: myAirPlay service
components.description: For the app myAirPlay: the AirPlay receiver "BMW iDrive" (UxPlay's protocol on the head unit). The iPhone's screen mirroring decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file and its sound into SmartXbar's CarLife input; a video sent with the AirPlay button (YouTube) played by its own player from the internet (mgu-uplink, through a proxy running as uid 13102). Opens the firewall for its ports only while the receiver runs.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: TVH Player service
components.description: For the app TVH Player: Tvheadend's channels on the head unit. The channel comes with one of the server's transcoding profiles (mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced by the server, AAC, MPEG-TS), is decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file (the app shows it while parked) and played into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Signs in once from the phone (a page on the car Wi-Fi, opened from the app's QR code); keeps the server, the user and the password (root's, 0600). Its internet goes through mgu-uplink, as uid 13103 only; the player runs as nobody.
components.author: aurelmarius

The picture shows while parked. Needs the myAirPlay service.

components.author: Leon Pllana

components.title: Vizualyse bus
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. The shared bus the Vizualyse tools use to ask each other to switch things off while they need the car's resources (Steam pauses Cast's cluster and HUD video while a game runs). Mosquitto 2.0.21 (MQTT) on a Unix socket only root's tools can reach; no network listener. Installed with the tools that use it; about 0.2 MB.

components.title: Cast to cluster
components.description: Plays a stream URL from your phone on the instrument cluster, the HUD or the media console, with its sound through the speakers: scan the QR code, paste a URL, pick where it goes. With hook111 armed, also CarPlay's own second screen (its cluster map) on the cluster or the HUD. Controlled by touch on the central screen too, parked or driving, where mgu-render is installed

components.title: Browser
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. A web browser (Chromium 156) running on the car, with WebGL 2, WebGPU (on the CPU; WebGL on the car's own GPU driver in an experimental GPU mode) and WebAssembly JSPI, shown on the central screen while parked and driven by touch, with its controls on a touch screen, parked or driving (Show on the screen, Back, Reload, Home, the resolution, GPU and game mode). Type addresses on the phone page: scan the QR code on the Browser app's touch screen or iDrive page. About 181 MB to download, 420 MB on the unit.

components.title: Cluster themes
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT YET TRIED ON A CAR. Whole-cluster themes drawn over the instrument cluster through cluster-render's panel target, under the car's own warning lights: eight families (G20 inspired 1 and 2, LCI inspired 1 and 2, Three-dial 1 and 2, Performance 1 and 2), each a Sport and a Comfort theme switched by the drive mode. Drawn by small shaders on the cluster with textures sent once (about 1.7-3.1 MB at start), so only a few KB/s of numbers cross the link while driving. Readings the car does not give show as --. Chosen on the central screen by touch, with a preview of each theme and a 10 s try on the cluster while parked (the Cluster themes iDrive app). About 12 MB.

components.title: Moonlight
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Streams games from a PC running Sunshine (GameStream) to the central screen (or the cluster or the HUD) while parked, decoded on the car's GPU, with the sound through the speakers and game controllers (a wired Xbox 360-style USB pad, or the phone as a pad; no Bluetooth pads). Pair the PC and pick a game on the phone page: scan the QR code on the iDrive Moonlight page.

components.title: Steam
components.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Windows games from your Steam library running on the car through Proton (Wine), on the car's own graphics drivers (64-bit Direct3D 9-11 games on Vulkan through DXVK by default, the rest on OpenGL), shown on the central screen while parked, with sound. Sign in to Steam and install games on the phone page (scan the QR code on the iDrive Steam page); play them from the iDrive or the phone. Touch is the mouse (a tap clicks); wired Xbox 360-style (XInput) USB controllers, up to four; no keyboard yet. Games that need the Steam client get an optional Run without Steam (gbe_fork). About 440 MB to download, 1.35 GB on the unit, plus the games.
